name: Conjure
description: Spell which does nothing on its own, but can be combined with other abilities.
effects:
Conjure must be combined with other skills to produce effects.
Combination only - combine with other skills:
• Sigil of Wind → Lightning Strike: 165 lightning damage, 200 impact on the sigil
• Blood Sigil → Blood Turret: decay turret for 30s
• Reveal Soul → Summoned Ghost: ghost ally for 280s
prereq_raw: Infuse Wind or Sigil of Wind
unlock_requirement: Requires Tier 2 (Breakthrough) in the Cabal Hermit tree
requires_skill: Infuse Wind or Sigil of Wind

name: Infuse Wind
description: Required: Activated Wind Altar. Increases the Impact and Attack Speed of your melee weapon for 3 minutes. Your stamina burn increases more quickly, however.
effects:
Wind Imbue on your melee weapon, lasting 180 seconds:
• +20% attack speed
• +50% weapon Impact damage
• Stamina Burn doubled (more tiring to swing)
Note: unlike elemental imbues, adds no elemental damage. Requires an activated Wind Altar.
unlock_requirement: Requires Tier 2 (Breakthrough) in the Cabal Hermit tree

name: Sigil of Wind
description: Required: Activated Wind Altar. Create a magic circle on the ground. Certain skills have additional effects when cast within this circle.
effects:
Combinations:
• Mana Push → Ethereal Bolt: long-range bolt, 25 ethereal damage, 100 impact
• Spark → Lightning Spark: 85 lightning damage, 75 impact
• Conjure → Lightning Strike: large explosion on the sigil, 165 lightning damage, 200 impact
• Fire and Reload → Lightning Bullet: pistol shot deals 1.6x damage converted to lightning

name: Blood Sigil
description: Creates a Sigil of Blood, enabling spell combos. Increases Corruption by 5%
effects:
* Increases Corruption by 5% on cast * Raises the player's Temperature Stage by 3 (heats the player up). In neutral temperature environments this increases the player's temperature delta by +28 .
Combinations:
• Dagger Slash → Blood Leech: inflicts Blood Leech Victim on target, player gains Blood Leech (+3% Corruption)
• Mana Push → Blood Tendrils: adds 50 Decay + 50 Physical damage and 25 Impact (+3% Corruption)
• Conjure → Blood Turret: decay turret for 30s, 15 Decay + 10 Impact per second (+6% Corruption)
• Mana Ward → Gift of Blood: +15% Physical, Frost and Decay damage for 60s, -1 Health per second (+3% Corruption)

name: Lockwell's Revelation
description: Passive: increases Elemental damage by 15% when Tired, and by 30% when Very Tired.
effects:
"Elemental" refers to Ethereal, Decay, Lightning, Frost and Fire damage.
Fatigue Tired (Rest 21-60%) gives +15% Elemental damage. Fatigue Very Tired (Rest 0-20%) gives +30%.
Tip: Rest drops by about 34% per day by default — skip sleep and Guard or Repair at a tent to reach Very Tired. Poutine removes 25% Rest instantly.
unlock_requirement: Requires Tier 2 (Breakthrough) in the Hex Mage tree

name: Rupture
description: Detonate all Hexes on nearby enemies, and all souls, for related damage.
effects:
Detonates all Hexes on all nearby Enemies for related effects. Removes Hexes from enemies (except Confusion), and consumes Revealed Souls. The detonations are AoE blasts, and the damage and impact of the blast depends on the Hex: * Chill: 50 Frost damage and 33 Impact * Curse: 50 Decay damage and 33 Impact * Doomed: 50 Lightning damage and 33 Impact * Haunted: 50 Ethereal damage and 33 Impact * Scorched: 50 Fire damage and 33 Impact * Pain: 50 Physical damage, 0 Impact * Confusion: 0 damage, 50 Impact
Combinations:
• Reveal Soul → Soul Rupture: consumes the Soul for an AoE blast (100 Ethereal, 66 Impact)
unlock_requirement: Requires Tier 2 (Breakthrough) in the Hex Mage tree

name: Elemental Discharge
description: Required: Infused Weapon Shoot a projectile of the element that is infused on your weapon.
effects: Fires an elemental projectile at the targeted enemy, or straight ahead if not locked on. Depending on the current weapon imbue, Elemental Discharge produces different projectiles: Fire Imbues: * 60 damage * 60 impact Frost Imbues: * 60 damage * 60 impact Ethereal Imbues: * 60 damage * 60 impact Decay and Poison Imbues: * 60 damage * 60 impact Lightning and Light Imbues: * 60 damage * 60 impact Wind Imbues: * 30 damage * 140 impact
unlock_requirement: Requires Tier 2 (Breakthrough) in the Kazite Spellblade tree

name: Gong Strike
description: Strike your weapon on your shield, removing the elemental infusion to make an explosion of that element.
effects: Consumes the current weapon imbue to create a short-range but wide area of effect explosion of the consumed element. The damage and impact of the skill is based on the Shield stats, however any Effects on the shield are not applied here, they are only applied to Shield Charge. Depending on the current weapon imbue, Gong Strike produces different effects: Fire Imbues: * Damage overrides to Fire * Damage multiplier: 2.2x * Impact multiplier: 1.4x Frost Imbues: * Damage overrides to Frost * Damage multiplier: 2.2x * Impact multiplier: 1.4x Ethereal Imbues: * Damage overrides to Ethereal * Damage multiplier: 2.6x * Impact multiplier: 1.6x Decay Imbues: * Damage overrides to Decay * Damage multiplier: 2.6x * Impact multiplier: 1.6x Poison Imbues: * Damage overrides to Decay * Damage multiplier: 2.0x * Impact multiplier: 1.0x Lightning Imbues: * Damage overrides to Lightning * Damage multiplier: 2.3x * Impact multiplier: 1.9x Wind Imbues: * No damage * Guaranteed to knock all affected targets down (deals 99x impact)
unlock_requirement: Requires Tier 2 (Breakthrough) in the Kazite Spellblade tree

name: Shield Infusion
description: Block an elemental attack. When you next block, an elemental explosion will burst from you.
effects: Activating this skill starts a blocking animation, during which you can block any type of attack (including magical blasts). If you block an attack which deals elemental (non- physical) damage during the animation, you gain a Shield Imbue of that element. In the case of multiple elements on one attack, the priority is first by which element dealt the most damage, but in the case of equal damage, the priority is then > > > > . When you have a Shield Imbue, the next blocked melee attack will create an area-of-effect explosion. The damage of the explosion is: * 1.3x equipped Shield damage as Ethereal damage * 2.0x equipped Shield damage as the element of the imbue (either ) * 2.0x equipped shield Impact damage See also: * Ethereal Shield Imbue * Decay Shield Imbue * Lightning Shield Imbue * Frost Shield Imbue * Fire Shield Imbue
unlock_requirement: Requires Tier 2 (Breakthrough) in the Mercenary tree
